title.en: Bake an effect into a sample

summary.en: The effect becomes part of the sound.

verifiedAgainst.title: SP-404MK2 Reference Manual — Resampling a sample (RESAMPLE)
SP-404MK2 Reference Manual — Configuring the sampling settings (RECORD SETTING)

text.en: Turn an effect on (for example [FILTER+DRIVE]) and set it.

text.ru: [RESAMPLE], [RECORD SETTING] → ROUTING = Mix ([CTRL 2]), затем пэд назначения.
text.en: [RESAMPLE], [RECORD SETTING] → ROUTING = Mix ([CTRL 2]), then the destination pad.

text.ru: Играй сэмпл — результат сохраняется на пэд; останови [REC] или пэдом.
text.en: Play the sample — the result is saved to the pad; stop with [REC] or the pad.

tryIt.ru: Запеки дисторшн на снейр и сыграй новый пэд.
tryIt.en: Bake distortion onto a snare and play the new pad.
